def test_constructed_complete_preflight_only_prepares_authorization_review():
    e, q, cs = fixture()
    assert e.initial_state() == State.NOT_STARTED
    ready = e.check(q, cs, now=10)
    assert ready.state == State.READY and not ready.execution_permitted and not ready.grant_issued
    assert e.submit_authorization_review(q, ready, cs, now=10) == State.PENDING
    assert e.submit_authorization_review(q, ready, cs, now=10) == State.PENDING
    with pytest.raises(PermissionError, match="no executor"):
        e.require_execution()
    assert not e._authorizations and not e._executions

def test_stale_or_modified_readiness_and_duplicate_request_substitution_refuse():
    e, q, cs = fixture()
    ready = e.check(q, cs, now=10)
    for bad in (
        replace(ready, catalog_digest="0" * 64),
        replace(ready, request_digest="0" * 64),
        replace(ready, evaluated_at=9),
    ):
        with pytest.raises(PermissionError):
            e.submit_authorization_review(q, bad, cs, now=10)
    e.submit_authorization_review(q, ready, cs, now=10)
    other = replace(
        q,
        resource_id="synthetic:resource:1",
        resource_identity=dict(e.resources)["synthetic:resource:1"],
    )
    other_claims = claims(other)
    other_ready = e.check(other, other_claims, now=10)
    assert other_ready.state == State.READY
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="duplicate"):
        e.submit_authorization_review(other, other_ready, other_claims, now=10)

def test_constructed_review_and_receipts_cannot_be_upgraded_or_certify_execution():

    e.submit_authorization_review(q, ready, cs, now=10)
    receipt = ExternalReceipt(
        "synthetic:receipt",
        digest(q),
        e.catalog_digest,
        None,
        0,
        100,
        False,
        "synthetic:canonical_ref",
        "synthetic:external_ref",
        FIXTURE,
    )
    for _ in range(2):
        with pytest.raises(PermissionError):
            e.record_authorization(q, ready, cs, receipt, now=10)
        with pytest.raises(PermissionError):
            e.record_execution(q, receipt, now=10)

        e.check(replace(q, classification=DOCUMENTARY), cs, now=10)

def test_dashboard_is_deterministic_and_separates_unknown_denied_selected_and_executed():
    c = module.load_catalog()
    a = module.dashboard(c, now=0)
    b = module.dashboard(c, now=0)
    assert a == b
    assert len(a["operations"]) == 27
    assert sum(r["preflight"]["state"] == "PREFLIGHT_BLOCKED" for r in a["operations"]) == 21

    assert not a["new_grants"] and not a["protected_resources_accessed"]

    assert "Unknown is distinct from denied" in module.render(a)

def test_actual_cli_reports_and_checks_never_execute_or_accept_a_resource_path():
    base = [sys.executable, "-m", "railway_detection", "application", "readiness"]
    a = subprocess.run(
        base + ["report", "--now", "0", "--format", "json"],
        cwd=ROOT,
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
    )
    b = subprocess.run(
        base + ["report", "--now", "0", "--format", "json"],
        cwd=ROOT,
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
    )
    assert a.returncode == b.returncode == 0 and a.stdout == b.stdout
    report = json.loads(a.stdout)
    assert not report["new_grants"]
    source = module.load_catalog()["sources"][0]["source_id"]
    for operation in ("M19-PERM-02", "M19-PERM-24"):
        p = subprocess.run(
            base + ["check", "--operation", operation, "--resource", source, "--now", "0"],
            cwd=ROOT,
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
        )
        assert p.returncode == 3 and not json.loads(p.stdout)["execution_permitted"]
    p = subprocess.run(
        base
        + [
            "check",
            "--operation",
            "M19-PERM-02",
            "--resource",
            "data/raw/NEVER_OPEN",
            "--now",
            "0",
        ],
        cwd=ROOT,
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
    )
    assert p.returncode == 2

source.function_source:
def test_acceptance_closure_detects_changed_documentary_catalog_without_touching_source_resources(
    tmp_path,
):
    from railway_detection.safety.resource_free_acceptance import bindings

    (tmp_path / "tests").mkdir()
    p = tmp_path / "docs/generated/master_reaudit/MISSION_26_READINESS_CATALOG.json"
    p.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
    p.write_text("{}")
    a = bindings(tmp_path)
    p.write_text('{"altered":true}')
    b = bindings(tmp_path)
    assert a["shared_digest"] != b["shared_digest"]
    assert not any("data/raw" in name for name in b["shared_source_sha256"])

def test_acceptance_closure_refuses_documentary_parent_alias_before_hash(tmp_path, family):
    from railway_detection.safety.resource_free_acceptance import bindings

    (tmp_path / "tests").mkdir()
    p = tmp_path / family
    p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    p.symlink_to(tmp_path / "NEVER_ENUMERATE")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="alias"):
        bindings(tmp_path)
